annotation.title_clean: 国务院办公厅关于发展体育赛事激发消费活力的意见
annotation.title_en: Opinions of the General Office of the State Council on Developing Sports Events to Stimulate Consumption Vitality
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院办公厅 (General Office of the State Council)
annotation.summary_en: General Office of the State Council opinions (Guobanfa [2026] No. 28) on developing sports events to stimulate consumption, covering event supply, integration with culture, tourism and technology, consumption scenarios, standards, talent and safety management. AI is mentioned only as a technology for event organisation; no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Aims to form a modern sports event system with Chinese characteristics by 2030.
Promotes integration of events with culture, tourism, commerce and technology including AI and big data.
Strengthens standards, talent training and monitoring of event-driven consumption.
Requires safety assurance: emergency systems, crowd-flow controls, organiser responsibility.
Encourages insurance products and financial support for event organisers.
